scenario_name: Utility peak-demand response by workload orchestration
service_role: measured site-load reduction against a utility-set target
system_boundary: 256-GPU production-grade cluster within one hyperscale cloud facility
comparison_design: measured power tracked against utility target and average base load
baseline_description: average cluster base load during the peak-demand period
evidence_note: Measured site-load control met two utility-set event targets; this was a bounded pilot, not sustained market operation.
notes: The data centre is the only active focal asset; grid and utilities do not increment focal-asset count.

scenario_name: Scenario C multi-direction V2X building-EV energy interaction
service_name_raw: renewable energy self-consumption through B2V and V2B energy sharing
service_role: modelled building-EV energy exchange and renewable-energy integration
system_boundary: district community with buildings, EVs, on-site BIPV/wind and grid imports
comparison_design: Scenario C V2X interaction compared with Scenario A without building-EV interaction
baseline_description: Scenario A uses the same focal classes without building-EV energy interaction and relies on grid charging
source_section: Battery circular economy in district communities
evidence_note: Both EV and building energy exchanges are coupled in Scenario C; the setting remains a synthetic/modelled community energy balance.
notes: Renewable generators and the grid are contextual resources and are not counted as focal asset classes.
